# Data Directory

[cite_start]This folder contains the datasets for the **Integrated Retail Sales Performance Tracking and Analysis** project[cite: 1].

## Contents
* [cite_start]**retail_sales_data.csv**: The raw input dataset containing transaction records[cite: 9, 11].
* [cite_start]**cleaned_retail_data.csv**: The processed output generated by the Python analysis script, featuring engineered columns for dashboarding[cite: 10, 15].

## [cite_start]Data Dictionary [cite: 9, 10]
* [cite_start]**Transaction ID**: Unique identifier for each sale[cite: 9].
* [cite_start]**Total_Amount**: Calculated field (Quantity * Price per Unit)[cite: 9].
* [cite_start]**Age_Group**: Categorical demographics (e.g., 18-25, 26-35)[cite: 10].
* **Customer_Segment**: Clusters derived via K-Means machine learning[cite: 11].
